notes.title: Next color option added: Reticence
notes.notes:
The new color option Reticence has been added! The dangers of corruption have spread to the classic break-out colors. While they retain the normal red-yellow-green colors, their appearance is distorted and unusual, shifting like sand in a storm. 

This color option can be unlocked by completing the Corrupted challenge (destroy 1200 corrupted blocks.) This marks one of two new custom options plan on adding before starting on the next major game mode. The next brick type, known as ichor, takes some inspiration from a certain enemy type in the final level. Don't know what that is? Well there's only one way to find out!

I'm also working on two new bonus gamemodes that I hope to have out after Christmas. A bossrush game mode, which will be unlocked by completing corrupted and a versus ai arena mode where you can battle it out gainst an AI. These are both works in progress and still need some time to be refined, but you can expect them both to be packaged with the new brick type. 

Thank you to everyone who has given this game a chance! It means the world to know that my little game has find its way into other peoples homes. I hope to get more content out as soon as I can!
